project_type: independent playable prototype with recovered artifacts preserved as references
legacy_input_api: UnityEngine.Input (provided by Unity; no separate UPM dependency)
notes: The uploaded archive contains WebGL player artifacts generated with Brotli compression; browser runtime validation is still pending.
Recovered assets are not imported into Assets, so the current WebGL data file is small by design; the archive's data.br expands to about 2.70 MB.
Tools/serve_webgl.py provides Content-Encoding: br for local hosting of Unity WebGL output.
Recovered assets are preserved outside the Unity Assets directory because some references are unresolved.
Cpp2IL/IL2CPP output is incomplete and WebAssembly pseudocode is not original C# source.
The project and recovered artifacts are not a byte-for-byte restoration of the original game.
